what_happened: A plumbing company owner used a chatbot to streamline their work order process across multiple systems, including Gmail, Slack, ServiceTitan, Quo, and a facility-maintenance client portal. The job involved reviewing work orders, finding available slots, confirming customers, and booking jobs. This process was completed within 10 minutes per order once the customer responded. This is an example of how to book work orders across five systems.
